Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment Inspection list 
 II, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The steam converting valve has the task to reduce the 
 hot steam within the pressure and at the same time to lower the steam 
 temperature on to the disired dimension

 control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
 safety shoes ... etc.
Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of valve hyd. station.
The valve must 
 be isolated mechanically by no steam in its line.
Be sure the line 
 must be completely drainage.
Check 
 thermometers and assure that temperature is less than 40 C.
Provide adequate 
 scaffolding, lighting, platforms or ladders.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set
Cleaning 
 articles (fluid, rags. etc)
Manual 
 puller, Feeler 
 gauge
Work to be Carried 
Out
Check the gland 
 packing (311) in regard of leakiness and if required immediately retighten.
Check the tightening moment of the hexagonal 
 nut (333) after the pressure test.
Check the 
 tightening moment of screws after the pressure test and required immediately 
 retighten.
Check the 
 traveling time in case of the plant standstill.
Check any 
 external leakage.
Check mechanical 
 wear (remark the point of leakage and welded it with suitable electrode.
